measurement_limits: sqlite_begin includes SQL execution and SQLite lock waiting; it is not pure database lock time. The 50ms busy retry backoff is only included in total.
The three concurrent readers share their reader Store and queue behind one another. Mutex duration cannot all be attributed to importer authorization.
Authorization delay is measured in the importer callback, not as a directly executed phase of each read. Repeated authorization values per operation refer to the same run and must not be summed.
A read total begins after the start barrier; importer total begins before authorization-entry/barrier preparation. Residual timings are not decomposed.
Independent SQLite completed before the 100ms deadline: six reads are controls, not successful cancellations. run02 misleading cancel=true rows are retained separately.

History samples are synthetic empty work metadata with unique roots/session IDs and one message, passing validState; directories/artifacts are not created for clones. Only FindByMessage processing is timed, not end-to-end host work or months of traffic.
Three samples support raw values, median and maximum only; no P95 or service promise inferred.

Build03 pins the main experiment harness but does not include a hash of validation_commit_test.go. The current commit-test hash is captured here; exact historical build-source binding should be supplied in delivery provenance.
